title: Atlas runtime policy manifest v5 (forex: short selling on the 1:2 margin book)
note: Successor of v4 (kept unchanged, sealed). Adds shorts_enabled, as the RiskPolicy and the MarketLoop must both hold it (CRYPTO false, FOREX true): in FOREX a SELL of a pair not held opens a short on the margin book and a BUY covers it; every new-risk gate, the stop-out and the weekend close apply to shorts as to longs. Read-only reference: core/policy_manifest.py compares the running application with it and any difference, or a missing/mismatching ratification, is BLOCK_NEW_RISK. Nothing is applied from this file and it can never enable live trading.
owner_approval: SEE_REGISTRY: ratification is recorded in ATLAS_MILESTONE_REGISTRY_v5.109 (this field is informational and is not trusted by the check)
